strip.basis: Requested grouping of eight separate tips. A detachable eight-tip carrier is not documented for these reload articles.

tray.basis: Requested 8 x 12 topology with manufacturer-listed 96 tips per tray and nominal system pitch; tray tolerances and support geometry are unknown.

box.basis: Container for the referenced refill tray; no measured box or detachable-strip mechanics asserted.

fit_to.unknown_policy: open; never passed when a required input is null

open_tasks.description: Document T01 fit_rule, tolerance extrema, sleeve gap and operating clearance for each selected tip/pipette pair.
Obtain tray/box dimensions, wall and seating geometry, mass, and evidence for any removable eight-tip carrier.
Obtain complete inner/outer axial profiles and tolerance data before native tip/tray geometry or physical collision claims.
Design strip loading and individual tip access separately, with the project motion/PVA checks.
Select and develop pipette actuation, nipple, mounting and tip attachment/removal; outside this task.
T01 has no validated tip-definition reference field. Keep its source and pins unchanged; add a validated reverse reference in a later collector-contract revision.

limitations: Documented nominal landmarks and slot frames are not complete CAD solids or toleranced interfaces.
Logical occupancy is a declared snapshot, not a stock ledger, sensor confirmation or consumption transaction.
Example instances do not place equipment in L01 or the extraction station. Their later adapters must consume this source.
No pipetting tool, robot motion, manufacturing or real tip compatibility is released.
